title: The Voice of Jacob
text: The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

title: Bless Me Too
text: … he let out a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, “Bless me too, O my father!”

title: Jacob's Ladder
text: And Jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven …

title: I Am with You
text: Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go …

title: Surely the LORD Is in This Place
text: Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it.

title: The House of God
text: … and he called that place Bethel …

title: Two Nations
text: Two nations are in your womb … and the older will serve the younger.

title: Grasping the Heel
text: … his brother came out grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob.

title: What You Sow
text: Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.

title: Neither Slumber nor Sleep
text: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
